groups.title: Stacked Streets
groups.summary: A vertical neighbourhood along the Bishan River that reimagines the shophouse for 2070s Singapore, combining homes, small businesses and public sky streets.

groups.title: The Wandering Archive
groups.summary: A speculative mobile library for Mongolian nomads adapting to cave dwellings in 2100, exploring cultural memory, weather data and the relationship between mobility and shelter.

groups.title: A Bridge
groups.summary: A collaborative 4.7 m bridge project exploring tension, structural behaviour, physical fabrication and folded metal connections.

groups.title: Spatial
groups.summary: An introduction to Rhino modelling through a building, a lived-in room and an object, using isometric drawings and digital models to tell a personal spatial story.

groups.title: Flow
groups.summary: A paper-model exploration of a structure that rises from the landscape, shaped by wave-like contours, walkable roof surfaces and sheltered spaces.

groups.title: Ribbon
groups.summary: A collaborative staircase study developed from AI-generated imagery through parametric modelling in Grasshopper and a BIM model in Revit.

groups.title: Previously
groups.summary: A collection of earlier work spanning architectural drafting, 3D modelling, visualisation, detail drawings, urban sketches and painting.
